style_rules.typography: Use Source Serif 4 semibold for primary page headings; Source Sans 3 for navigation, forms, secondary headings and body text.
style_rules.language: Use Noto Sans Devanagari as a Hindi fallback. Keep unmodified font binaries and OFL notices with distributed code.
style_rules.navigation: Desktop layout has a 242px white sidebar, a white top bar and a pale grey-blue canvas. At 760px the sidebar becomes an overlay with Escape, focus containment and a dimmed background.
style_rules.panels: Use 8–10px panel corners, fine grey separators, restrained 1px borders and 16–24px spacing between related panels.
style_rules.checklist: Use 15–16px checklist text, an ID above or beside each item, a native completion checkbox and separately labelled note and revision controls.
style_rules.states: Blue indicates actions and progress. Pair status colours with text labels. Respect reduced-motion preferences and retain visible keyboard focus.
style_rules.headings: Use serif headings at 30–39px, short muted introductions and honest count-based progress. Geometric map contours may decorate quiet reading cards.
